how_to_apply: Download the application form attached to the official notification.
Fill out the application form completely.
Prepare a resume containing complete qualifications, CGPA or percentage marks, and experience details.
Compile the filled application form, resume, soft copy of all degree certificates from high school onwards, and proof indicating date of birth into a single PDF file.
Send the single PDF file by email to [email protected] on or before 27 October 2026.
Ensure the subject of the email is strictly stated as "Application for Laboratory Technician position".
important_instructions: The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Candidates must ensure their eligibility before appearing for the interview. Candidates must bring original degree certificates, certificates, and experience certificates at the time of verification during the interview. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Applicants are solely responsible for the authenticity of the information and documents submitted. Selected candidates will be governed by the administrative conditions of the DST and Delhi Technological University, Delhi.

faq.question: Q1. What is DTU Laboratory Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: Delhi Technological University has invited applications for 1 Laboratory Technician position for the project under the National Quantum Mission (NQM), Department of Science & Technology (DST).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Laboratory Technician post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by email is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. degree or a three-year Diploma in Engineering and Technology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for applicants is 50 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly emolument of Rs. 18,000 plus HRA as per DST norms.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must send a filled application form, resume, and soft copies of all degree certificates and age proof in a single PDF file to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted and called for an interview.
